trackerLog.subject: Framefield
trackerLog.note: The live website is Tracker, not Framefield. Logs are XML in artifacts/Tracker-Log named Date+Hash. Tracker loads every xml file every few seconds. README in that folder is the write protocol.
trackerLog.decision: Tracker is a separate always-on log app. Framefield is only the subject field in XML. Do not name log files Framefield_Tracker.
